status: 100 completed draft manuscripts; no publication or commit by writer
researchMethod: Read actual GM2023–2026 diagnostic-monitor rows in full source PDFs, including calibration scopes, enable conditions and thresholds. Incidental/inhibit mentions were not accepted. Selected ambiguous layouts were visually inspected.

Read complete older GM, Subaru, Mazda and Toyota manufacturer diagnostic procedures reproduced by Operation CHARM. Extracted HTML text and inspected embedded detection/flowchart figures. MR2 figures additionally OCRed with numerical and branch tables visually verified.

Read original Volkswagen Phaeton BAP/BRP factory manual edition11.2014 hosted by VWTS: actual DTC mapping rows and full referenced sensor, regulator, injector and controller procedures. Rendered physical pages91,93,96,103–105,206,210–212 were inspected. Citations use physical PDF indices, not printed folios.

Read full Prius PHEV current-sensor and cooling-valve sections reproduced by MyToyo, including explicit SAE/enhanced mappings and all diagnostic branches. Shared Toyota source ID reused; root should union codeMentions with writer45, not overwrite either record.
Read official Mitsubishi2022DG/02 actual DTC rows, confirmation sequences and linked diagnosis pages. P0078 cross-reference error recorded explicitly; P2018 and P044B linked procedures read.
Authored each article as explicit original prose. Assembly helpers attach metadata and citations only; they do not generate generic title-substitution templates.

Used atomic claim.py only after source review. Retained100 accepted code strings, excluded initial4000 globally, and validated identity, source-page ranges, draft status and exact repeated substantive paragraphs.

sourceScopeNotes: GM file-level vehicle matrices are not used as proof that every code applies to every listed vehicle.
Mirrored historical factory manuals are labeled by original publisher and mirror. They do not establish universal vehicle or VIN applicability.
MyToyo groups PriusXW60PHEV material as2023–2026 without an exact factory revision; articles retain that limitation.
Mitsubishi pages are bounded to the2022DG/02engine-control collection and exact controller procedure. No unverified model or VIN fitment is added.

High-voltage battery, high-pressure fuel, starter interlock and stored hydraulic-energy work is kept within professional service boundaries. No owner-level high-voltage probing, hydraulic depressurization procedure or relay bypass is supplied.
rejectedOrUnwrittenCandidates: P24D6/P24D7 were already reserved by43; P1575 by42; P0781/P0784 by44. Their proposals were rejected and no batch41 article was written.
Modern GM P1200/P1812/P1407 and C0522 meanings did not match canonical definitions; used only independently matching older procedures where found.
Legacy GM P1658/P1644/P1845/P1532/P1533/P1654/P0361 and several legacy B/C suspension codes were rejected for canonical definition conflicts.

Subaru P0957/P0958 described back-up-light relay faults instead of canonical manual-shift-mode faults; Mazda P0813 described reverse hydraulic sequence behavior instead of canonical reverse-output circuit. Rejected.
P2013 was not located in the referenced Forester turbo material. Did not assume the promised lead existed.
Mitsubishi P044E actual source combines an intermittent canonical code with high label and low-voltage criterion. Rejected rather than force-fitting.
DJXA P0148/P01C8/P01C4/P011F/P2810 were left to writer44; no competing claims or manuscripts.
